999008199.text: へー、イェルカって名前はその村長から来てたんだ

localizations.en: Huh, so that's where the name Jelka came from.

999008199.text:
多分あの出会いからアタシは生まれ変わったのさ。
サンから、イェルカにね……

localizations.en: I think that meeting changed my whole life. I was reborn, from San to Jelka...

999008199.text:
っと、昔話をしていたら、ついたみたいだよ。
仙人の実の群生地にね

localizations.en: Oh, looks like we're here. This should be where Sage Fruit grows.

999008199.text:
なんか、小さい羽が生えてるやつがいるんだけど。
魔物の巣は反対の方角じゃなかったっけ？

localizations.en: There are some little winged ones here. Wasn't the monster nest supposed to be in the opposite direction?

999008199.text:
もしかしたら魔物は、この実に凶暴化を抑える
成分があることを本能的に感じ取ったのかもね

localizations.en: Maybe the monsters instinctively sensed that these fruits have components that suppress their violent tendencies.

999008199.text:
コウセンがこの島を実験場にしていたのなら、魔物たち
も島民同様の中毒になっていてもおかしくはない

localizations.en: If Kosen was using this island as a testing ground, it wouldn't be strange for the monsters to suffer from the same kind of addiction as the islanders.

999008199.text:
あー……そもそも今回の任務は著しく凶暴な魔物が
いるから「管理」しろって話だったよね

localizations.en: Ah... our mission was to manage some unusually violent monsters in the first place, right?

999008199.text:
なんでこんな小さな島でいきなり凶暴な魔物が
出てくるのか謎だったけど……コウセンのせい？

localizations.en: I was wondering why such violent monsters would suddenly show up on this tiny island... So it's Kosen's fault?

999008199.text:
なんでもかんでもコウセンが悪いで片づけるのも
どうかとは思うけど、一因ではあるだろうね

localizations.en: I don't think we should blame everything on Kosen, but he's certainly part of the problem.

999008199.text:
なんにせよあの魔物の子どもも「管理」対象だし……
ここで片付けとく？

localizations.en: Either way, that monster's offspring should itself be managed... Should we take care of it here?

999008199.text: そうだね、この魔物の子どもを……

localizations.en: Yeah, we should deal with it here and now...

999008199.text: 魔物の子どもを倒す

倒すしかないだろうね。痛い目に合わせて
人は怖いと覚え込ませるんだ

localizations.en: We'll have to take it down. Let's give it a good scare so it learns to fear humans.

999008199.text: あ、命までは奪わない感じ？

localizations.en: Oh, so we're not killing it?

999008199.text:
この子は大人しい個体だろ、むしろ生かして
子孫を増やした方が「管理」しやすいはずさ

localizations.en: This one seems pretty docile. Actually, keeping it alive to breed would make management easier.

999008199.text: な～る。それじゃ、死なない程度にバキッとな

localizations.en: Ah, gotcha. So we just rough it up a bit without going too far.

999008199.text: 魔物の子どもを見逃す

たった１匹、しかも大人しい子どもだ。
見逃してやるさ

localizations.en: It's just one youngling, and a well-behaved one at that. We should let it go.

999008199.text:
まあ、お優しいこと！　そういうと思ったけど。
アレでしょ、粋じゃないってヤツ

localizations.en: Well, aren't you the softhearted one! Though I figured you'd say that. Something about it not being chic, right?

999008199.text:
アタシの決め台詞を取るんじゃないよ。
まあそうなんだけどさ

localizations.en: Do I say that that often? But yeah, that's about right.

999008199.text:
アタシらがするべきは「管理」であって
根絶やしにするのとは訳が違うんだ

localizations.en: Our job is management, not extermination. There's a difference.

999008199.text:
生態系の均衡を保ちつつ、平和な環境の現状維持。
この魔物が実を食べて種を運ぶのも自然の摂理さ

localizations.en: We maintain balance in the ecosystem while preserving a peaceful environment. This monster eating the fruit and spreading seeds is just part of nature's way.
